entities.summary: Nabhani, a notable figure in the history of Oman, associated with Nabhani Dynasty and Portuguese Invasion (1154–1507). Preceded by Nabhani Kings. Their legacy influenced Albuquerque sacks Muscat, massacring the population and seizing the port and Portuguese build Fort Jalali and Fort Mirani overlooking Muscat harbor.
